panama_PNSH_1:
"Goal/Purpose": "To ensure that every person in this country has sustained access to quality water and basic sanitation, sufficiently safe to lead a dignified, clean, healthy, and productive life.",
"Action/Intervention": "Progressively expand the coverage of water and sanitation services at the national level and eliminate inequalities in access in an inclusive and equitable manner, in accordance with users' needs.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water and sanitation services at the national level.",
"Target Audience": "Every person in this country; users of water and sanitation services.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Universal access to quality water and sanitation services, with expanded national coverage and elimination of inequalities in access."
panama_PNSH_2:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve the efficiency of drinking water and sanitation services by optimizing existing infrastructure, improving treatment plant operations, improving rural water systems in their operation and distribution of water directly to households, and reinforcing, improving, and optimizing sanitary sewer services.",
"Action/Intervention": "Execute an indicative portfolio of 174 projects; improve existing drinking water and sewer systems; optimize existing infrastructure; make treatment plant operations more efficient; improve rural water systems in their operation and distribution of water directly to households; reinforce, improve, and optimize sanitary sewer services; optimize water consumption through micro- and macro-metering; implement strategies for leak reduction.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Drinking water and sanitation services, including drinking water systems, treatment plants, rural water systems, and sanitary sewer services.",
"Target Audience": "Around 1 million people across the country who will benefit from the projects.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Around 1 million people across the country will benefit through the execution of 174 projects, with budgeted resources allocated to resolve the most critical problems in the provision of drinking water and sanitation services."
panama_PNSH_3:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase coverage of drinking water services by expanding water supply coverage at the urban and rural levels in communities where service is deficient.",
"Action/Intervention": "Carry out studies and corresponding designs, and construct and/or expand new infrastructure to meet new demand, including 136 construction and/or expansion projects for new treatment plants, rural water systems, wells, water systems, conveyance lines, and supply systems between 2015 and 2020.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Drinking water supply services in urban, rural, peri-urban, and rural and indigenous areas.",
"Target Audience": "Communities where drinking water service is deficient, including urban and rural populations and rural and indigenous areas, particularly communities with more than 10,000 inhabitants requiring treatment plants of greater capacity than a rural water system.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "By 2020, drinking water supply coverage reaches 98% of the urban population and 70% of rural and indigenous areas."
panama_PNSH_4:
"Goal/Purpose": "Provide all households with basic sanitation conditions through increased sanitation services.",
"Action/Intervention": "Improve sanitary sewer systems in cities, eliminate latrines across the country, expand the existing sanitary sewer network, and construct treatment plants and sanitary sewers.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Sanitation services in cities and across the country.",
"Target Audience": "All households.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased sanitation services, all households provided with basic sanitation conditions, elimination of latrines across the country, and expanded sanitary sewer coverage."
panama_PNSH_5:
"Goal/Purpose": "Planning for water and sanitation systems at the national level and supporting the sustainability of investments in water and sanitation improvements.",
"Action/Intervention": "Conduct studies, research, and pilot projects to evaluate the behavior of supply, demand, and water-supply efficiency; develop 12 projects classified under water and sanitation studies and water and sanitation plans.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water and sanitation systems at the national level.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified in the target.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Evaluation of supply, demand, and water-supply efficiency, and development of 12 projects under water and sanitation studies and plans."
panama_PNSH_6:
"Goal/Purpose": "Provide an important basis for decision-making and ensure efficient management of water resources to meet the needs of various uses for inclusive socio-economic growth.",
"Action/Intervention": "Have basic information about water, such as the amount of water available in watersheds, projected demands, and ecosystem needs.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resources in watersheds; human consumption, agriculture, industry, energy, transport, tourism, and biodiversity.",
"Target Audience": "Decision-makers and users across human consumption, agriculture, industry, energy, transport, tourism, and biodiversity.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved decision-making and efficient management of water resources to meet the needs of various uses."
panama_PNSH_7:
"Goal/Purpose": "Management of water-resource availability.",
"Action/Intervention": "Permanent execution of projects, including investments for new studies and to improve water-resource monitoring capabilities: studies of water balances of surface sources; National Water Resources Information System; hydrometeorological monitoring; estimation of environmental flows.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resources.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly provided in the target.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved water-resource monitoring capabilities."
panama_PNSH_8:
"Goal/Purpose": "To organize freshwater use and consumption, make demand more efficient through technological tools, and monitor compliance.",
"Action/Intervention": "Organizing user demand; incorporating technological tools that improve demand efficiency; monitoring compliance; carrying out studies for the use of treated wastewater in cities; implementing projects for the use of treated wastewater in cities; improving irrigation system technology; developing new options for reserving water; improving irrigation distribution systems.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Freshwater demand management, urban water use, and irrigation systems.",
"Target Audience": "Water users, cities, and irrigation systems.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "More efficient water use and consumption, monitored compliance, use of treated wastewater in cities, improved irrigation technology and distribution systems, and development of new water reservation options."
panama_PNSH_9:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase the availability of freshwater by increasing water-resource storage and conservation capacity to meet current and future needs, and prevent future shortages caused by the effects of an unpredictable climate.",
"Action/Intervention": "Carry out studies and research to evaluate and demonstrate the feasibility of increasing water availability; construct infrastructure to conserve water, including multipurpose reservoirs and accelerated rainwater harvesting in the metropolitan area and provincial capitals; convert reservoirs currently used exclusively for energy into multipurpose reservoirs; establish multipurpose reservoirs in the Indio, Santa María, La Villa, Perales, Parita, Oria, and Ocú rivers; implement rainwater harvesting projects; initiate social, environmental, and economic studies and technical designs for a Bayano water treatment plant; undertake rainwater harvesting, cloud seeding, and water reserves for agriculture.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resources and freshwater supply systems; metropolitan area and provincial capitals; the Indio, Santa María, La Villa, Perales, Parita, Oria, and Ocú rivers; the eastern sector of the province of Panama; agriculture.",
"Target Audience": "Populations requiring drinking water; food production, energy generation, industry, transport, recreation, and ecosystems; the population in the eastern sector of the province of Panama; agriculture.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased freshwater availability and water storage capacity for drinking water consumption, food production, energy generation, industry, transport, recreation, ecosystems, new uses, and urban growth; conservation of water through reservoirs and rainwater harvesting; prevention of future water shortages caused by an unpredictable climate; guaranteed availability for agriculture and urban growth."
panama_PNSH_10:
"Goal/Purpose": "Preventive management of water-related risks.",
"Action/Intervention": "Estimate future water availability to meet future demands and take preventive measures to mitigate impacts and increase the resilience of people and infrastructure to extreme events.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water management.",
"Target Audience": "Decision-makers in water management, people, and infrastructure.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Mitigated impacts of extreme events and increased resilience of people and infrastructure to extreme events."
panama_PNSH_11:
"Goal/Purpose": "Mitigate the impacts of climate events, prevent them from becoming disasters, reduce the vulnerability of people and public and private water and sanitation infrastructure, and thereby maintain the country's growth levels and protect its natural resources, including water.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop tools to identify risks, reduce their impacts, prepare for emergencies, financially protect investments, and plan for the recovery and restoration of infrastructure; diagnose the risk situation; implement the National Program for Hydrological Extremes Management; develop adaptation and mitigation plans, including climate change; carry out dredging and channeling of rivers; and implement open and underground river drainage in urban areas.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Risk management in the water and sanitation sector, including rivers and urban drainage areas.",
"Target Audience": "People, and public and private water and sanitation infrastructure.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced impacts of climate events, prevention of disasters, reduced vulnerability of people and water and sanitation infrastructure, maintenance of the country's growth levels, protection of natural resources including water, and recovery and restoration of infrastructure."
panama_PNSH_12:
"Goal/Purpose": "Monitor climate events and their effects, and install early-warning systems for disasters and extreme climate events.",
"Action/Intervention": "Invest in the purchase, installation, operation, and replacement of instruments necessary to monitor climate events and their effects; implement ten programmed projects; attend to disasters and extreme climate events; establish an early-warning system for floods and landslides in watersheds; develop an agroclimatic system for the agricultural sector; strengthen SINAPROC's Desinventar platform; install early-warning systems in schools; determine a vulnerability index and define government action thresholds for extreme events; purchase and operate hydrometeorological stations for the agricultural sector; continue operating SINAPROC's tide-monitoring system; install tide gauges; install sensors for electrical discharges; acquire a satellite-image reception station.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Watersheds, agricultural sector, schools, and climate/disaster monitoring systems.",
"Target Audience": "SINAPROC, the agricultural sector, schools, and government.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Early-warning systems installed; monitoring instruments purchased, installed, operated, replaced, and continued in operation; strengthened Desinventar platform; vulnerability index and government action thresholds for extreme events determined; hydrometeorological stations, tide gauges, electrical discharge sensors, and a satellite-image reception station acquired or installed."
panama_PNSH_13:
"Goal/Purpose": "Guaranteeing water sustainability.",
"Action/Intervention": "Improving water governance; ensuring effective inter-institutional coordination; strengthening institutions so they have the technical, operational, logistical, and financial capacities necessary to exercise their mandate; establishing an adequate regulatory framework and institutional capacity to enforce it; promoting an educated society actively participating in the responsible management of water; and making the structural adjustments presented in this Plan.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water; water governance; water management.",
"Target Audience": "Institutions; water users; society.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Effective inter-institutional coordination; institutions with the technical, operational, logistical, and financial capacities necessary to exercise their mandate; an adequate regulatory framework and institutional capacity to enforce it; an educated society actively participating in the responsible management of water; and a level of satisfaction adequate to the needs of all water users."
panama_PNSH_14:
"Goal/Purpose": "To help resolve conflicts over access to water and prevent future ones in a participatory way, and through user education and awareness on water use.",
"Action/Intervention": "Strengthen spaces for consultation and participation (forums, meetings, agreements, information dissemination, user regularization); create and/or strengthen the operation of watershed committees; strengthen the capacities of mediators in water-resource conflict resolution; strengthen the capacities of local authorities and institutions in water-resource conflict resolution; carry out these actions continuously during the Plan's validity.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resources",
"Target Audience": "Water users, watershed committees, mediators, local authorities, and institutions",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Resolved conflicts over access to water, prevention of future water-resource conflicts, and strengthened consultation, participation, and conflict-resolution capacity during the Plan's validity."
panama_PNSH_15:
"Goal/Purpose": "To update regulations whose management has become obsolete in relation to the country's evolution and to fill legal gaps identified during the Plan's preparation.",
"Action/Intervention": "Review and adjust the regulatory framework during the Plan's validity; undertake short-term actions for priority regulatory reforms; disseminate the reforms; build capacity in their application; update and/or develop existing regulations.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Regulatory framework and legal/regulatory management under the Plan.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified in the target.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reviewed, adjusted, updated, and/or newly developed regulations; legal gaps filled; priority regulatory reforms disseminated; capacity built for their application."
panama_PNSH_16:
"Goal/Purpose": "Institutional strengthening to implement the PNSH.",
"Action/Intervention": "Capacity-building for current staff; incorporation of new staff with technical specializations related to the management, administration, protection, supervision, monitoring, and evaluation of the water resource; implementation of 23 projects across four areas: strengthening human-resource capacities, institutional strengthening and equipment, organization of integrated water governance (regulation, planning, operation, service provision), and creation of the Hydrological, Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Oceanographic Information Service (SIHAGO).",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resource management and integrated water governance.",
"Target Audience": "Current staff, new staff, and institutions involved in management, administration, protection, supervision, monitoring, evaluation, regulation, planning, operation, and service provision related to the water resource.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Strengthened institutional capacity to implement the PNSH through improved human resources, equipment, integrated water governance organization, and creation of SIHAGO."
panama_PNSH_17:
"Goal/Purpose": "Reinforce education, capacity-building, and information on the use, protection, and conservation of water within the framework of the National Strategic Plan for Science, Technology, and Innovation coordinated by SENACYT.",
"Action/Intervention": "Implement 12 planned investment projects, including short-term investments, organized into the following lines of action: training for better water use; research for better water management; and planning and training of professionals in water (identification of technical careers).",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Water resources; use, protection, conservation, and management of water.",
"Target Audience": "Professionals in water; participants in training, education, capacity-building, and research activities.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved education, capacity-building, information, research, and professional training related to better water use and water management."
